question: Should this test-only Nextcloud Talk mock repair receive a real-behavior-proof override after its exact-head focused checks are refreshed against current main?
rationale: The patch has no product runtime behavior to demonstrate, but the external-contributor policy otherwise makes its test/typecheck-only evidence a human-only merge blocker.

options.title: Override Test-Only Proof
options.body: Accept the focused fail/pass type-check and test evidence as sufficient for this test-only repair once the current merge result is confirmed.

options.title: Request Additional Evidence
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor supplies a redacted terminal recording or linked artifact showing the current-main type-check failure and branch success, then reassess the override.

recommendation.title: Override Test-Only Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the focused fail/pass type-check and test evidence as sufficient for this test-only repair once the current merge result is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of the tsgo test lanes makes this person the strongest available decision owner for a test-only proof exception.
